name: Meal Appeal
statusNote: New in Forever.  From Wowhead’s Forever database.
footerSourceNote: This quest is new in Forever: its text, givers, objectives and rewards come from Wowhead’s Forever database until the beta confirms them. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
My son, Migi, always takes off to play with his friends all day. I tell him to pick up a lunch at Borstan's, but I know he almost never does, because he comes home starving. These kids think their games are more important than their own bodies!

Please, stop at Borstan's Firepit and tell him you're there to deliver Migi's lunch. You can almost certainly find Migi behind Grommash Hold with the rest of his friends.

Duties keep me here during the day and I can't watch over his every meal.
narrative.objectives: Visit Borstan's Firepit and tell him Thatog wants you to deliver Migi's lunch to him personally.
narrative.offerRewardText: Of course. Migi's parents and I have an arrangement to give Migi a bagged lunch every day, but I can only ensure the boy gets his food if he actually comes in to pick it up.Sometimes, he doesn't pick up his meal multiple times a week, and I wonder where he gets the energy to stay out and play.

chain.subtitle: 4 quests at level 15, 2,950 XP in all.

quests.name: Philmor's Favor
quests.objectiveText: Bring the Gatehouse Shipment to the stockroom entrance located in Trias' Cheese shop in the Trade District

quests.name: Yelmak's Medley
quests.objectiveText: Take some cuttings from the Cattails and Speargrass growing around the water flows in the Valley of Honor and return to Kor'geld in Yelmak's Alchemy and Potions

quests.name: Gatehouse Goods
quests.objectiveText: Carry the Gatehouse Shipment up the stairs in Trias' shop and leave it outside the door.
